properties.name: genesis.logging.pattern.enabled
properties.description: Apply the library log pattern (timestamp, level, service, logger, trackingId, message).

properties.name: genesis.logging.header.enabled
properties.description: If true, the HTTP filter inits trackingId from allow-listed headers.

properties.name: genesis.logging.header.fields
properties.description: HTTP header allow-list. First non-blank wins. Unlisted headers are ignored.

properties.name: genesis.logging.header.path-patterns
properties.description: Optional Ant path patterns. Empty means all URLs when header tracking is enabled.

properties.name: genesis.logging.kafka.header.enabled
properties.description: If true, the record interceptor inits trackingId from allow-listed Kafka headers.

properties.name: genesis.logging.kafka.header.fields
properties.description: Kafka header allow-list for record listeners. First non-blank wins.
